judgments.reasoning_cat1: A detailed absolute exclusion with defined sub-branches and a hostile-fire exception that is itself defined; intricate but specific.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It bars precisely the discharges from owned or occupied premises that the Pollution Liability Endorsement (c178) insures, an unreconciled tension between two endorsements to one policy.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A clean two-limb exclusion of clean-up demands and governmental suits.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It excludes the 'attendant clean up costs of property owned by another party' that the Pollution Liability Endorsement (c178) expressly covers.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A conventional pollutants definition identical to the one in the pollution coverage endorsement.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It duplicates c179 word for word while serving the opposite function, which is consistent in wording but underlines the overlap between the two pollution provisions.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: 'The limits of liability stated under this insurance shall apply separately with respect to each of the following locations' names three corporate entities rather than locations, and says nothing about whether the each-incident or the aggregate limit multiplies.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It lists only three of the dozen named insureds in Form 009-052 (c092), sits against the anti-stacking rule in c187 and the increased limits in c173, and directly affects how the HPL aggregate in c044 applies.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The text is scrambled and internally contradictory: it says coverage 'shall be [lim]ited to actual compensatory damages' and shall not apply to trebled damages, yet promises to pay one-third of the total sum awarded as treble damages.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Endorsement 10 (c203) deletes Form 009-133 and declares it null and void, so this exclusion remains printed in the policy although expressly cancelled.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The endorsement's text is jumbled, with the operative condition ('when conducted by or on behalf of the named insured') separated from its clause, though the substituted definition itself is clean.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It creates a second, broader 'products hazard' definition alongside the printed one (c017), which requires the injury to occur away from the insured's premises.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: 'Charitable health care services in their communities' is an undefined class and the provision conclusively deems such acts within the scope of employment.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It is a verbatim duplicate of Endorsement 9 (c090), and it enlarges coverage for medical incidents which HPL Additional Condition B (c050) purports to confine to the professional liability Part.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The added paragraph (g) defines the employee by reference to 'Section (d) of this endorsement', but this endorsement has no section (d) — the referent is a paragraph of Form 009-109 WI.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It duplicates the identical paragraph added by Endorsement 9 (c091) and depends on paragraph (d) of c056, which itself excludes licensed Wisconsin physicians.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A standard nuclear exclusion keyed to identified insurers and to the Atomic Energy Act; definite technical criteria.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It is cross-referenced by the Pollution Liability Endorsement (c180) consistently.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A short exclusion tied to medical payments and first-aid supplementary payments; clearly bounded.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It fits with the Supplementary Payments provision (c002) and the medical payments coverage (c143) without conflict.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Three enumerated conditions with a geographic proviso; technical but specific.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It coheres with limbs A and B of the same endorsement and with the defined terms that follow.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: An extensive definitions block incorporating statutory meanings and precise gram thresholds; little interpretive slack.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Its expanded 'property damage' meaning applies only within this endorsement and does not disturb the policy definition (c018).

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Boilerplate attaching language; nothing to construe.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Its inception-date default sits oddly with the endorsement's issue date of 06/21/1996, but the stated effective date is 03/01/1996.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: It identifies the deleted forms only by number, and '009-118 (10/92)' must be matched to a form printed elsewhere without a matching designation on its face.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It nullifies the Trebled Damages Exclusion (c194) and the earlier Policy Territory endorsement (c172), both of which remain physically in the policy, so the instrument as delivered contains cancelled provisions.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A one-line attachment instruction identifying a form by number; definite.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The attached Form 009-118 (2/96) (c205) quotes a differently worded version of the same Wisconsin statute than the deleted form (c172), so the operative territory provision changes mid-term.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: It says the territory provisions are amended 'so as to comply with' a statute and then quotes the statute, without stating the amended wording, so the operative text must be constructed from the quotation.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It replaces the earlier Form 009-118 (c172) deleted by Endorsement 10 (c203) and overlays the HPL territory provision (c045), which itself is fragmentary.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Boilerplate attaching language; nothing to construe.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Its inception-date default is at odds with the mid-term issue date of 07/19/1996, but no stated effective date contradicts it.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A simple address correction for a listed location; concrete.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It amends the CGL schedule of locations, which is further amended by c209, c215 and c217, so the schedule must be read across four endorsements.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Boilerplate attaching language; nothing to construe.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Same inception-date default against a mid-term issue date; no substantive conflict.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A schedule addition with a class code and premium basis; purely factual.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It expands the 'insured premises' as defined in c149 mid-term, consistently with the other schedule amendments.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Boilerplate attaching language; nothing to construe.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The endorsement bears an effective date of 07/09/1996 while this clause makes it effective on the policy's inception date 'unless otherwise stated', so the two dates must be reconciled.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A one-line addition of a single named entity; definite.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It enlarges the Additional Named Insureds list (c092), which also disclaims automatic coverage for newly acquired entities, while the Broad Form grants 90-day automatic coverage (c163).

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Boilerplate attaching language; nothing to construe.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The endorsement's stated effective date is 08/20/1996, which the inception-date default must yield to.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: It attaches 'Form 008-145' without describing its content, and no form of that number appears in the schedule of endorsements or the policy.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Because the referenced form is nowhere in the instrument, its effect on the rest of the policy cannot be determined from the document as a whole.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Boilerplate attaching language; nothing to construe.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The endorsement's stated effective date is 11/21/1996, so the inception-date default is displaced by the 'unless otherwise stated' proviso.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The addition and deletion are stated concretely, though the added entry gives square footage where other schedule entries give class codes.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The deleted location, '200 W. Silver Spring', does not appear in the CGL schedule of locations printed in the policy, so the deletion has no evident referent.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Boilerplate attaching language; nothing to construe on its own words.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: This endorsement bears an effective date of 07/31/1997, after the 03/01/1997 expiry of the policy period, so the attachment language cannot be squared with the declared term.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: It deletes '1000 North 92nd St., Wauwatosa' whereas the schedule lists a 92nd Street clinic in Milwaukee, so the description does not match the scheduled entry.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The endorsement is dated 07/31/1997, months after the policy period ended on 03/01/1997, yet purports to amend the schedule of locations in Form L9259a retroactively.
